index 2003b7e..be1aa3c 100644
--- a/tests/test_milestones.py
+++ b/tests/test_milestones.py
@@ -18,6 +18,28 @@ from test_preflight import reject
 graph = test_dependencies.graph
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("alias", ["development", "feature", "feature-chain"])
+def test_symbolic_milestone_destinations_are_rejected_before_ticket_work(graph, alias):
+    configure_plan(graph)
+    if alias == "development":
+        graph.git("symbolic-ref", "refs/heads/dev", "refs/heads/integration")
+    else:
+        target = "dev"
+        if alias == "feature-chain":
+            graph.git("symbolic-ref", "refs/heads/bridge", "refs/heads/dev")
+            target = "bridge"
+        graph.git("symbolic-ref", "refs/heads/integration", "refs/heads/" + target)
+    refs = graph.git("show-ref")
+    result = run_until_wait(graph)
+    assert result.returncode == 1
+    record = graph.record()
+    assert "symbolic" in record["failure"]["message"].lower()
+    assert record["attempts"] == [] and record["gates"] == []
+    assert graph.git("show-ref") == refs
+    assert graph.git("rev-parse", "dev") == graph.base
+    assert not (graph.output / "qa-request.json").exists()
+
+
 @contextmanager
 def foreground(graph, operation="run"):
     """Own a real foreground runner; bound fixture waits and always reap it."""
diff --git a/tests/test_qa_promotion.py b/tests/test_qa_promotion.py
index d284701..81228d3 100644
--- a/tests/test_qa_promotion.py
+++ b/tests/test_qa_promotion.py
@@ -29,6 +29,29 @@ def waiting(graph, process, milestone):
     )
 
 
+def test_deep_invalid_decision_is_rejected_and_later_approval_can_promote(graph):
+    configure_plan(graph)
+    with foreground(graph) as process:
+        first = waiting(graph, process, "M1")
+        request = json.loads(Path(first["qa_request"]).read_text())
+        nested = "[" * 10000 + "0" + "]" * 10000
+        (graph.output / "qa-decision.json").write_text(nested)
+        rejected = wait_for(graph, process, lambda r: r.get("qa_decision_status") == "rejected")
+        assert rejected["outcome"] == "awaiting_human_qa" and process.poll() is None
+        assert rejected["qa_observations"][0]["status"] == "rejected"
+        assert Path(rejected["qa_observations"][0]["artifact"]).read_text() == nested
+        assert rejected["attempts"] == first["attempts"]
+        assert rejected["tickets"]["02"]["attempt"] == rejected["tickets"]["04"]["attempt"] == 0
+        assert graph.git("rev-parse", "dev") == graph.base
+        assert graph.git("rev-parse", "integration") == request["feature_revision"]
+        approve(graph, request)
+        waiting(graph, process, "M2")
+        assert graph.git("rev-parse", "dev") == request["candidate_revision"]
+        assert graph.cli("stop", graph.output).returncode == 0
+        process.wait(timeout=10)
+        assert process.returncode == 2
+
+
 def test_two_foreground_milestones_require_exact_acceptance_and_consume_each_decision(graph):
     configure_plan(graph)
     graph.config["max_repairs"] = 2
diff --git a/ticket_harness/git.py b/ticket_harness/git.py
index b9f6d8c..77460f6 100644
--- a/ticket_harness/git.py
+++ b/ticket_harness/git.py
@@ -28,6 +28,15 @@ def worktree(repository: Path, path: Path, revision: str) -> Path:
     return path
 
 
+def require_direct_branches(repository: Path, *branches: str) -> None:
+    """Named integration destinations must not alias another branch."""
+    for branch in branches:
+        ref = f"refs/heads/{branch}"
+        git(repository, "check-ref-format", ref)
+        if git(repository, "for-each-ref", "--format=%(symref)", ref):
+            raise GateFailure(f"Branch {branch} must not be symbolic")
+
+
 def carry_changes(previous: Path, source: Path) -> None:
     """Copy current working contents without altering the rejected tree or Git identity."""
     for path in source.iterdir():
